title: The Fast Breeder Reactor

anim.title: A strange reactor
items: And makes more fuel than it burns

segments.say: Imagine a stove that cooks your food and leaves you with more firewood than you started with. That's the idea of a breeder reactor.

anim.title: The trick
items: Fast neutrons fly out of plutonium fuel
Some hit uranium-238 around the core

segments.say: In its core, plutonium splits and throws out fast neutrons. Some hit ordinary uranium-238 placed around the core, and turn it into new plutonium. Fuel is bred.
Ordinary reactors slow their neutrons with water. A breeder keeps them fast, so it is cooled by liquid sodium metal instead.
India's Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor, five hundred megawatts, is at Kalpakkam in Tamil Nadu. Loading of its core began in March twenty twenty-four.

anim.title: Why India cares
items: That opens the door to thorium

segments.say: India has little uranium but a great deal of thorium. Breeders build up the fuel and, later, can turn thorium into usable uranium-233.

anim.title: The catch
items: Sodium burns in air and water

segments.say: It isn't easy. Sodium catches fire in air and reacts with water, so the engineering is demanding and the build has taken many years.

anim.title: For your answer
items: Breeds more fissile fuel than it uses

segments.say: For GS Three: a fast breeder makes more fuel than it burns, and it is stage two of India's three-stage nuclear plan.

sources: Department of Atomic Energy / PIB, 4 March 2024: commencement of core loading at the 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor, Kalpakkam, built by BHAVINI; the PFBR uses U-Pu mixed oxide fuel and a U-238 blanket; will produce more fuel than it consumes; second stage of the three-stage programme

quiz.why: It turns uranium-238 into plutonium-239: new fuel.

quiz.q: What cools a fast breeder reactor?
quiz.why: Water would slow the neutrons; sodium keeps them fast.
The 500 MW PFBR is at Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu.
